body:
Stacked on #7278 → #7273.

## Summary
- Voiceprints only name a speaker on a unique, confident match, so a meeting with three remote attendees and two saved voiceprints always left one "Speaker N". Now, when the remote channel (system audio) holds exactly one speaker per remote participant and every pair but one is already known — from earlier hints or this run's matches — the last speaker is named as the last person.
- Strict count gate: a no-show or an uninvited guest means nothing is inferred. Speakers with no clean speech to embed still count as speakers, so the inference uses the transcript's full speaker set, not just the embeddable one.
- New pure `anlg_voiceprint::complete_by_elimination`; the plugin wraps assignments in a small `SpeakerNaming { basis: Voiceprint { score } | Elimination }` so elimination hints are written with `source: "elimination"` and no fabricated confidence. Nothing in the desktop reads those fields, only `human_id`.
- Elimination now runs even when no exemplars exist, so naming one of two remote speakers by hand implies the other on the next refine.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo test -p voiceprint -p tauri-plugin-transcription` (17 + 59; new: count-match, single-open-pair, no-show/guest refusal, direct-mic exclusion, prior-hint + new-match combination, hint shape)
- [x] `cargo clippy --locked -p voiceprint -p tauri-plugin-transcription --lib --no-deps -- -D warnings` shows only the pre-existing `explicit_auto_deref` (`matching.rs:60`), `collapsible_if` and `needless_borrow` in untouched code
- [ ] 3-remote meeting with voiceprints for two attendees: confirm the third is named after refine and the hint has `source: "elimination"`
- [ ] Same meeting with one attendee absent: confirm the remaining unmatched speaker stays "Speaker N"

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes automatic speaker labeling on transcripts; wrong labels are possible if diarization or participant counts are off, though strict count matching limits guessing.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **process-of-elimination** naming for the last unmatched remote speaker when system-audio diarization has exactly one speaker per remote participant and every other pair is already known (from hints or confident voiceprint matches).
> 
> The voiceprint crate exports **`complete_by_elimination`**, which only returns a pair when speaker and participant counts match and exactly one speaker and one person remain unassigned; no-shows and extra guests yield no
title: Name the last remote speaker by elimination when counts match
